amendment.observed_failure: The declared Scripts/NativeScript directory was a literal path, so the original nested launcher was still denied; tests did not run.
amendment.diagnosis: Official Swift Build source uses literal output nodes for shell script phases and cannot grant unknown dynamic directory contents. Recursive input setting alone would not cover original Python rsync/framework outputs and original metadata intermediates.
amendment.decision: Align only MiniApps Debug/Release ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING=NO with the original AI target. Keep original executable scripts, engines, provenance checks and IO inventory. App entitlements, installed-app sandbox and runtime permission broker are unchanged.
